## History

Fourth lived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) where she served as a handmaiden to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). She assisted [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in preparing the lodge for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's arrival. Later, she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) watched from a window as [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) walked together in the garden, confirming the pair's reconciliation. She eventually married an [American](../codex/factions.md#american) named Tom.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P38](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0038)_

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fourth--lavendar-lewis.md)

Fourth serves as a handmaiden and servant to Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). In this role, Fourth assists in preparing the household for important visitors, including [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). She remains close by to observe and support Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) during significant personal moments, such as the reconciliation between Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P47](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0047), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), +3 more_

- Serves under — handmaiden and servant (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P47](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0047)</sub>

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fourth--shirley.md)

Fourth and [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) are close chums who live and work together at the stone house. They assist one another with household duties, such as helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's arrival. Together, they observe key developments in the household, such as watching Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) reconcile in the garden.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), +2 more_

- Comrade of — chums living and working together at the stone house (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>
